classificationPriority.note: AH-2 only emits ACTIVE_PRODUCTION_REF from current verified/frozen resolver or consumer chains.

classificationPriority.rule: no ACTIVE_PRODUCTION_REF and references contains SOURCE_EVIDENCE_REF or MANIFEST_REF
no active/evidence/manifest reference and references contains DERIVATIVE_REF

classificationPriority.note: v1 AH-2 current-reference map does not infer supersession from filenames or recency; absent explicit evidence this class remains unused.

classificationPriority.rule: references exist but none establish verified active/evidence/derivative provenance

flagRules.BASENAME_COLLISION: AH-1 basenameCollisionGroup is non-null; this is not resolver collision by itself
flagRules.RESOLVER_COLLISION: only explicit AH-2 resolver ambiguity may set this flag
flagRules.UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL: only explicit external provenance without verified ingest may set this flag
flagRules.REVIEW_REQUIRED: PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN, UNREFERENCED, explicit resolver collision, unverified external, or exact duplicate candidate

traits.verifiedEvidence: references contains SOURCE_EVIDENCE_REF or MANIFEST_REF or ACTIVE_PRODUCTION_REF or DERIVATIVE_REF

verifiedEvidenceIndex.canonicalIdentityPolicy: Use only canonicalKey already present in AH-2 references. Never derive IDs from filenames or path arithmetic.
verifiedEvidenceIndex.pathFallbackPolicy: When a verified asset lacks an explicit canonicalKey, index it as REPOSITORY_PATH_ONLY without inventing semantic identity.
